risk_description: Touchpoint improvements may leave upstream eligibility burdens untouched
Simplification may create difficult edge cases requiring discretion and appeals
Dashboard visibility may encourage optimization of visible metrics rather than meaningful outcomes
Referral protocol may fail if agencies lack aligned incentives and decision rights
Participation may become symbolic if authority remains unchanged
Community partners may absorb institutional burden without adequate funding
Reduced user effort may increase frontline staff workload without support
Learning loop may produce reports without decision authority or resource commitments
